summary_1line: After hearing Hanuman’s report on Sita, Angada proposes attacking Lanka immediately, but the wise Jambavan insists they obey Rama’s command and report back first.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada stands among the gathered monkeys on the seashore, passionately proposing the immediate destruction of Lanka.
The aged bear-king Jambavan calmly addresses the excited monkey warriors, urging them to return to Rama instead of attacking Lanka.
